# Josie Pye

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P25](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0025), [v3 ch.Autumn P3](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0003)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_
- **Family:** [Aunt Atossa](../character/aunt-atossa.md) (cousin)

## Appearance

Josie Pye wears dresses featuring flounces, which are considered particularly stylish for the fall season.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXI. Where the Brook and River Meet P8](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0008)_

## Personality

Josie Pye is known for her disagreeable nature and sharp tongue, showing little hesitation when asking questions. Despite her flaws in popularity, she possesses a natural talent for walking board fences and has demonstrated skill in needlework by winning first prize for knitted lace.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXIII. Anne Comes to Grief in an Affair of Honor P6](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0006), [v1 CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life P24](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0024), [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P31](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0031), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006), [v1 CHAPTER XXXVII. The Reaper Whose Name Is Death P33](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0033)_

## History

During a party at Diana's house, Josie Pye dared [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to walk the ridgepole of Mr. Barry's kitchen roof, leading to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) falling and breaking her ankle. Later, when [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) had moved to town to attend Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy), Josie visited Anne's boarding house alongside [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md) and Ruby, revealing that an Avery scholarship was available.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXIII. Anne Comes to Grief in an Affair of Honor P11](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0011), [v1 CHAPTER XXIII. Anne Comes to Grief in an Affair of Honor P15](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0015), [v1 CHAPTER XXIII. Anne Comes to Grief in an Affair of Honor P30](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0030), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIV. A Queen’s Girl P0](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIV. A Queen’s Girl P10](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0010), +2 more_

## Quotes

> “Oh, that reminds me,” said Josie, “Queen’s is to get one of the Avery scholarships after all. The word came today. Frank Stockley told me—his uncle is one of the board of governors, you know. It will be announced in the Academy tomorrow.”
>
> — Josie Pye — [v1 CHAPTER XXXIV. A Queen’s Girl P24](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0024)

> "If I don’t pass this year I’m coming back next. My father can afford to send me. Anne, Frank Stockley says that Professor Tremaine said Gilbert Blythe was sure to get the medal and that Emily Clay would likely win the Avery scholarship."
>
> — Josie Pye — [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P14](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0014)

> "I dare you to climb up there and walk the ridgepole of Mr. Barry’s kitchen roof."
>
> — Josie Pye — [v1 CHAPTER XXIII. Anne Comes to Grief in an Affair of Honor P11](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0011)

> "I don’t believe anybody could walk a ridgepole. You couldn’t, anyhow."
>
> — Josie Pye — [v1 CHAPTER XXIII. Anne Comes to Grief in an Affair of Honor P9](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0009)

> "Your new dress is rather becoming to you, Anne. Really, you look almost pretty in it."
>
> — Josie Pye — [v3 ch.Autumn P2](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0002)

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--josie-pye.md)

Josie Pye maintains an antagonistic relationship with [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), standing out as one of Anne's few distinct foes in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) who eventually accuses her of copying a prize story. Their rivalry began in childhood with dares during games, including a incident where Josie dared [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to walk the ridgepole of Mr. Barry's kitchen roof, resulting in [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) falling and breaking her ankle. Their mutual hostility persists through their school years alongside their social circle.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXIII. Anne Comes to Grief in an Affair of Honor P6](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0006), [v1 CHAPTER XXIII. Anne Comes to Grief in an Affair of Honor P11](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0011), [v1 CHAPTER XXIII. Anne Comes to Grief in an Affair of Honor P15](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0015), +4 more_

- Rival of — daring each other in games  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXIII. Anne Comes to Grief in an Affair of Honor P6](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0006), [v1 CHAPTER XXIII. Anne Comes to Grief in an Affair of Honor P37](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0037)</sub>
- Enemy of — one of her few foes in Avonlea who accused her of copying her prize story (since v3)  <sub>[v3 ch.Relationships P2](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0002)</sub>

### [Aunt Atossa](../character/aunt-atossa.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/aunt-atossa--josie-pye.md)

[Aunt Atossa](../character/aunt-atossa.md) is a relative of Josie Pye. Specifically, [Aunt Atossa](../character/aunt-atossa.md) is a cousin to Josie's mother.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Life P41](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0041)_

- Relative of — Aunt Atossa is cousins with Josie's mother (since v3)  <sub>[v3 ch.Life P41](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0041)</sub>
